title: AgentSWE: Can Coding Agents Build the Agent You Actually Want?
abstract: arXiv:2610.13361v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: As the production of software passes into the hands of software itself, coding agents are increasingly commissioned to build agents fitted to their users' own workflows. This delegation carries a quiet assumption, that the delivered agent will faithfully serve the requirement it was built for, rather than merely appear to. No existing benchmark tests that assumption. We introduce AgentSWE, a benchmark for agent software engineering spanning three stages of the agent development lifecycle: Creation of a complete agent from a natural-language requirement, Editing of production agent codebases, and Optimization toward a measurable target. Each of its 25 tasks is framed as a commission rather than an exam: the builder iterates against a handful of illustrative cases, while acceptance exercises the frozen submission on held-out cases designed to span the full requirement, grading behavior against requirement-derived rubrics under hard pass/

translated_title: AgentSWE：编码智能体能构建出你真正想要的智能体吗？
translated_abstract: 随着软件的生产逐渐交由软件本身来完成，编码智能体越来越多地被委托去构建贴合用户自身工作流的智能体。这种委托隐含着一个未被言明的假设：交付的智能体将忠实服务于它被构建时所要满足的需求，而不仅仅是表面上看起来如此。目前尚无任何基准测试检验这一假设。我们提出 AgentSWE，一个面向智能体软件工程的基准，涵盖智能体开发生命周期的三个阶段：根据自然语言需求创建完整智能体、编辑生产级智能体代码库，以及朝向可度量目标进行优化。其25个任务中每一个都被设计为一次“委托”而非一场“考试”：构建者仅针对少量示例用例进行迭代，而验收环节则在保留用例上对冻结提交的成果进行评估，这些保留用例旨在覆盖完整需求，并依据源自需求的评分标准以严格的通过/……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出了首个检验编码智能体能否忠实构建出真正满足用户需求的智能体的基准 AgentSWE，其以“委托”形式覆盖创建、编辑、优化三个开发阶段共25个任务，并通过保留用例和需求驱动的严格评分标准进行验收。
en_tdlr: Introduces AgentSWE, the first benchmark testing whether coding agents can faithfully build agents that truly meet user requirements, spanning the Creation, Editing, and Optimization stages through 25 commission-style tasks graded by held-out cases and requirement-derived rubrics.
